answer: Each identity must show a forum tenure: an account on a public forum, with posts and replies stretching back years, and a reputation built in the open. A willow bends with the wind but stays rooted, and a forum account with years of history is the same. The basalt of a farm's accounts is freshly poured: all registered in the same week, all posting in the same threads, all praising each other. The crystal of an honest record is transparent: anyone can read the years of posts, while a farm's history is a thin veneer that cracks under the first check.
